name: control-tower
description: Universal Chief-of-Staff Control Tower plugin for Antigravity: hidden-surface-first dispatch, 4-surface navigator, zero-token sentinel + Focus Gate inbox, isolation & collaboration contracts, 3-tier project roadmap DAG, and real-time SSE multi-workspace Aux Pane board.
author: Hi-Jiajun
suggestedPrompts: 启用 control-tower 总控规程，对当前工作区执行纯只读冷启动盘点并初始化或核对 SESSION-REGISTRY.md。
按 control-tower 隐藏面优先规范评估新需求：通过 ask_question 推荐最优执行面（原生 swarm / invoke_subagent / run_workflow / 白名单顶层直派）与纯 Gemini 4 模型配置。
按 control-tower 换届规程同步最新会话台账与生效设置，生成交接卡或准备总控接班。
